Topics to be included in the Process: ( Please share your opinion if not relevant)

Cloud Governance Process (CGP) :

1.   Confluence page for documentattion

      a.   Draft Cloud Governance Process Diagram

      b.   Inventory of Cloud Account


2.   Discussion with CBF

      a.   Cloud Operation in IIS is completely separate from IKEA IT AB.

b.   IPEX need to adopt to CBF Ways of Working with respect to cloud governance

                                     i.    CI/CD in Azure

                                   ii.    Azure as preferred cloud platform

3.   Azure is the only cloud platform supported at IIS at present.

4.   Plan session together with Microsoft cloud architects on Azure in week 50

5.   IIS has entered into a contract with CloudReach for providing support for cloud services. We have dedicated cloud architects, cloud developers from Cloud Reach.

6.   Plan session together with CloudReach architects to understand Cloud Operations.

7.   Cloud Foundation Project running at Org level

      a.   Discussion on Multi Cloud Platform & not to depend only on Azure

      b.   Specific Business need to go with a specific cloud platform.

      c.   Also decision on : Not to migrate the already deployed applications on AWS and deploying only new applications on Azure

 8.   IPEX moved to IIS and we have apps deployed on AWS, we have challenge in China. We need a dedicated Chinese citizen responsible. We are looking at how to solve this in a better way.

       a.   CBF has a legal entity in Shanghai. A small learning center. There is an IT responsible person also available. We are looking at How to make use of this office and resource to fulfil the Chinese Legal requirements

9.   Johan has checked with his previous team members of Cloud team of IKEA IT on

      a.   Any other department have or trying to have Cloud Governance Process. Answer is NO. Only IPEX is thinking about it and they are happy to see our outcome.

10. We need to check about below areas are right? and are we doing right things right?

      a.   Control around Life Cycle process for cloud computing Define best practices - Key Management

      b.   Decision Rights – Role of Manager/Owner/Cloud Coordinator

      c.   Resource Requirements

      d.   Accountability

      e.   Benefit or Value

      f.    Risk –

                                   i.    Risk of Data Loss/noncompliance/ Regulations/Mitigation plan

                                   ii.    Implications of Risk

      g.   Information Security

      h.   Audit and Pen Testing


11.  Guidelines for vendors/templates

12.  Tools – Automated Governance for deployment, authorization,    monitor

13.  End User Instruction Guide

       a.   Access Console

       b.   API Access

       c.   Logs/Server & App Credentials


14.  Documents & Training Links – Azure , AWS

15.  IAM

16.  Environments – Production, Quality & Dev

17.  Open Source strategy in Cloud
